nl_question: List all department names ordered by their starting date.
sparql_partial_uri:
PREFIX : <http://valuenet/ontop/>
SELECT ?T1_dname WHERE { ?T1 a :department . ?T1 :dname ?T1_dname . ?T1 :mgr_start_date ?T1_mgr_start_date . } ORDER BY ASC (?T1_mgr_start_date)
sparql_complete_uri: SELECT ?T1_dname WHERE { ?T1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/department> . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/dname> ?T1_dname . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/mgr_start_date> ?T1_mgr_start_date . } ORDER BY ASC (?T1_mgr_start_date)

nl_question: find all dependent names who have a spouse relation with some employee.
how many female dependents are there?
sparql_partial_uri:
PREFIX : <http://valuenet/ontop/>
SELECT (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :dependent . ?T1 :sex ?T1_sex . FILTER(?T1_sex = 'F') . }

nl_question: Return the first names and last names of employees who earn more than 30000 in salary.
Find the number of employees of each gender whose salary is lower than 50000.
sparql_partial_uri:
PREFIX : <http://valuenet/ontop/>
SELECT (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) ?T1_sex WHERE { ?T1 a :employee . ?T1 :sex ?T1_sex . ?T1 :salary ?T1_salary . FILTER(?T1_salary < 50000) . } GROUP BY ?T1_sex
sparql_complete_uri: SELECT (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) ?T1_sex WHERE { ?T1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/employee> . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/sex> ?T1_sex . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/salary> ?T1_salary . FILTER(?T1_salary < 50000) . } GROUP BY ?T1_sex
